tours.name: Required Fields on a New Contract

name_i18n.en_US: Required Fields on a New Contract

tours.description: Learn what happens when you save a contract without its required fields, such as the employee and the start date.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn what happens when you save a contract without its required fields, such as the employee and the start date.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Contracts are managed from the Employees app.

description_i18n.en_US: Contracts are managed from the Employees app.

steps.title: Employees menu
steps.description: The Employees menu holds the employee list and the contracts.

description_i18n.en_US: The Employees menu holds the employee list and the contracts.

steps.title: Contracts
steps.description: Every contract of every employee is listed here.

description_i18n.en_US: Every contract of every employee is listed here.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to start a contract.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to start a contract.

steps.description: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

description_i18n.en_US: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

steps.description: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

steps.title: Read the message
steps.content: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

steps.description: The message names the missing fields, for example the employee, the contract reference or the start date. A contract without them cannot be saved because payroll depends on them.

description_i18n.en_US: The message names the missing fields, for example the employee, the contract reference or the start date. A contract without them cannot be saved because payroll depends on them.

steps.title: Discard
steps.content: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

steps.description: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real contract.

description_i18n.en_US: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real contract.
